definitions.explanation: A wind blowing directly against one's direction of travel. Also used figuratively for adverse circumstances or opposition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The bicycle won't move forward because of the headwind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}にもかかわらず、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: Despite economic headwinds, the company continued to grow.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧ (facing toward) and ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind). Used both literally for a wind blowing against your direction of travel, and figuratively for adverse conditions.

LITERAL USAGE:
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}: strong headwind
- {向|む}かい{風|かぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: a headwind blows
- {向|む}かい{風|かぜ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to press forward against the wind

USAGE:
Common in news and business contexts to describe adverse circumstances:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}: economic headwinds
- {向|む}かい{風|かぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to face adversity head-on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}い{風|かぜ}→追い風：14352_oikaze⟧: tailwind; favorable circumstances

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{逆風|ぎゃくふう}→逆風：14368_gyakufuu⟧: adverse wind (more literary/formal; preferred in figurative contexts like politics and business)
